# Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** John Jumper, Richard Evans, Alexander Pritzel, Tim Green, Michael Figurnov, Olaf Ronneberger, Demis Hassabis, et al.  
**Year:** 2020  
**Journal:** Nature  
**DOI:** [10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2)  
**Publisher:** [https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-021-03819-2](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-021-03819-2)

**Keywords:** alphafold, protein structure

## Abstract

We provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even where no similar structure is known.
